App serves HTML. Let me test GraphQL query and authentication. Check the dev user seeded. Let me look at the seed and query graphql endpoint.

Let's test an actual GraphQL query, e.g. a public query. And check login flow. Let me inspect .env for WEBAPP_DEV_USER_PW and query.

action.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== env keys ==="; grep -E '^(DATABASE_URL|TEST_DATABASE_URL|SHADOW_DATABASE_URL|VALKEY_SERVER|VALKEY_PORT|VALKEY_PERSISTENT_SERVER|VALKEY_PERSISTENT_PORT|STORAGE_BUCKET|STORAGE_URL|CRYPTO_SECRET|WEBAPP_DEV_USER_PW)' .env | sed 's/=.*/=<set>/'; echo "=== SESSION_KEY set? ==="; grep -c '^SESSION_KEY=.\+' .env; echo "=== members/account count ==="; docker exec postgis psql -U postgres -d ffy_dev -tAc 'select count(*) from "Member"; select count(*) from "Account";' 2>&1
